description: Change how one monitor is presented on a status page: its public name, description, group or position; or, with section_id, a group section's heading. An omitted field is left alone. A section member's heading is its section's, so its public_group does nothing. Not read-only; idempotent.

inputSchema.description: `update_status_page_component` argument. An omitted field is left as it is.

heading.description:
The section's public heading, at most 50 characters; blank shows the
group's name.

monitor_id.description:
The monitor id whose curation is being changed. Send this or
`section_id`.

public_group.description: Ignored on a section member, whose heading is the section's.

section_id.description: A section (from `get_status_page`) whose `heading` is being changed.

inputSchema.title: UpdateComponentArgs

name: update_status_page_component
title: Update status page component
